policies.title: Leave Policy
policies.text: Employees accrue 18 days of annual leave per calendar year. New employees receive a prorated balance based on their start date. Vacation request notice: submit annual leave requests at least five working days ahead. Managers approve team requests; People Operations handles escalations.

policies.title: Leave Policy
policies.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days each year. Notify your manager before your scheduled start when possible. Medical documentation may be requested after three consecutive working days.

policies.title: Attendance Policy
policies.text: Standard working hours are 40 hours per week. Record attendance on each scheduled workday. Flexible schedules require manager agreement.

policies.title: Remote Work Policy
policies.text: Eligible roles may work remotely up to three days each week with manager approval. Teams set shared in-office days. Protect company information when working away from an office.

policies.title: Benefits Policy
policies.text: Employees scheduled at least 30 hours weekly may enroll in health coverage. Enrollment begins on the first day of the month after 30 days of employment.

policies.title: Promotion Policy
policies.text: Promotion decisions consider sustained role performance, demonstrated skills, and organizational need. Managers document evidence and discuss proposals with People Operations.

policies.title: Expense Policy
policies.text: Pre-approved business travel meals are reimbursable up to 60 USD per person per day. Submit itemized receipts within 30 days. Personal expenses are not reimbursed.

policies.title: Data Access Policy
policies.text: Access employee records only for an authorized work purpose. Managers may view direct reports; People Operations may access records for approved HR duties. Do not export or disclose personal data without authorization.

policies.title: Employee Conduct Policy
policies.text: Employees are expected to maintain a respectful workplace. Report safety, discrimination, harassment, or misconduct concerns to People Operations through established internal channels. Misconduct should be reported to People Operations.
